newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA launches new flights to Jeddah.
newsitem.headline: SIA launches new flights to Jeddah.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd (SIA) said on Wednesday it planned to launch a new passenger flight to Jeddah, Saudi Arabia later this year.
The non-stop two-way air service, to begin on August 3, would operate three times a week, the company said in a statement.
SIA said it would end its twice-weekly flights to Dhahran, Saudi Arabia, with the introduction of the new services.
The statement said Singapore received about 17,000 visitors from Saudi Arabia last year as bilateral trade rose by 30 percent in 1996 to Singapore $7.57 billion.
